about: The ledger of books: chosen (queued), being transcribed (in progress), published, waiting for an answer from Tom, and rejected. Rules: notes/selection.md. `order` is a suggestion, not an obligation.

books.title: Diary of the Late Rajah of Kolhapoor, during His Visit to Europe in 1870
books.author: Rajaram, Rajah of Kolhapur; edited by Edward W. West
books.eligibility: Checked 2026-11-19: not in the Project Gutenberg catalogue, The Online Books Page (page images only, if listed), Wikisource or Faded Page; only print-on-demand reprints found. Not checked: WorldCat, Distributed Proofreaders in progress. Reprints seen: Creative Media, CreateSpace, Forgotten Books (print on demand). A Marathi translation (2025) is not an English edition. Re-checked 2026-11-19: Gutenberg catalogue, web search (only the 1872 edition, a Forgotten Books print-on-demand reprint, and the 2025 Marathi translation). Editor's death date not found: see the book log and Questions for Tom.
books.note: Using the University of California scan diaryoflaterajah00rajarich (200 leaves) rather than the Google scan. Short; a Google scan of a Michigan copy (greyscale, clean on the sampled page): check every page before starting. Editor's introduction and notes are part of the book.
books.question: Editor Capt. Edward W. West (Bombay Staff Corps; captain by 1870): death date not found. Publish on the reasoning that he cannot have been alive in 1955? Book is otherwise ready (preflight PASS, audit 30/30).
